decisions.reason: The page-limit impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY covering reduced spacing and possible client content reduction.
The streamlined layout approach does not change the requirement to integrate the selected photos.
Reducing spacing and custom section treatments does not change the Agua Arc identity or required brand assets.
The one-page cover-letter requirement is already independently captured from the same message; the layout modification adds no further change to it.
The general spacing and layout treatment does not alter which tables must be integrated or replaced.
The layout-density decision does not change the required PDF format, file count, email submission, or export properties.
The client only offers contingent future content reduction; the requirement to integrate the narrative in the fixed section order remains unchanged.
The spacing and visual-complexity changes do not affect Canva access, ownership, editability, or asset policy.
The source decision does not modify the requirement that hyperlinks remain functional in the saved PDF.
The source concerns the separate GreenLatinos RFQ and has no effect on the TPEC proposal.
The client's planned review and possible content reduction do not change the agreed single revision round.
The layout and page-reduction instructions do not change any draft, revision, submission, or deadline date.
